test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The subordinates will __vituperate__ us when they are irritated.
solution:
The correct answer is Praise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'vituperate' is 'bitter and abusive'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Blame- Feel or declare that (someone or something) is responsible for a fault or wrong.
 
• Abuse- Use (something) to bad effect or for a bad purpose; misuse.
 
• Praise- Express warm approval or admiration of. 
 
• Demean- Cause a severe loss in the dignity of and respect for (someone or something).
 
 
 
• Hence, '**praise**' is the most appropriate antonym of the word '**vituperate**'.
 
• Thus **option 3** is the correct answer.
